## Reports and Context

It is important thatwe begin to look at digital data ina 360degree context of thedifferentchannels& tactics.

For example,lookingata paid search report alone and only looking at reach (impressions)and initial response (CPC/CPIR) data is very misleading.

44%of all people who click on paid search results have been exposed to display advertising prior to theclick.Therefore it iswrong to attribute1oo%performance to paid search orthe‘last click'.

You need to look at paid and organic search data togetherand with broader engagement/performancemetrics.

Morebroadlyyouneed to regularly lookatdata inoverallcontextofa campaignand or programand thisalso requires you to develop an overall digitaland or broadermarketing scorecard for your organisation.

## Key Takeaways

1.Adoption bariers relate to management&culture,not data&technology!

2.Begin with questions /desired insights first, not data

3.You cannot manage what you cannot measure

4. What you measure will determine what you do

5.Measure what matters most (customer engagement,conversion & satisfaction)

For example,lookingata paid search report alone and only looking at reach (impressions)and initial response (CPC/CPIR) data is very misleading.

44%of all people who click on paid search results have been exposed to display advertising prior to theclick.Therefore it iswrong to attribute1oo%performance to paid search orthe‘last click'.

You need to look at paid and organic search data togetherand with broader engagement/performancemetrics.

Morebroadlyyouneed to regularly lookatdata inoverallcontextofa campaignand or programand thisalso requires you to develop an overall digitaland or broadermarketing scorecard for your organisation.
